name: Devouring Details
summary: Interactive reference manual on interaction details and motion, with 23 downloadable React components.
description: An interactive manual for designers who care about how interfaces feel, not a linear course: 23 chapters in three units (Principles, Prototypes and Resources), each exploring a detail of interaction design through live prototypes and examples from production apps. Registration is a one-time $249 and includes source code for 23 React components and a private community.
contains: 23 chapters in 3 units: Principles, Prototypes, Resources
23 downloadable React components with source code
footage recorded from live React components
prototypes such as Scroll Strip, Radial Timeline, Morph Surface, Logos Carousel and Line Graph
